subject: Urgent: Multiple teams requesting promo credits — Snowbound AI
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@snowbound.ai>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Requesting promo credits for multiple teams

Hi Olga / Ben,

Hope you’re well — quick ask. We ran two more internal pilots this month and several product teams (search, recommendations, and ingestion) are asking for promo/top-up credits so they can run 2-week experiments. I attached a CSV with the requested allocations and screenshots of the provisioning pages.

This is on top of the credits we received last quarter — happy to share context but the teams are on tight timelines. Can you approve expedite credits for these teams? We’re trying to finish evaluations before quarter-end.

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Head of Data Platforms
Snowbound AI
attachments: promotion-requests.csv, screenshot-login-activity.png

From: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@snowbound.ai>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-05T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Requesting promo credits for multiple teams

Alex — thanks for the details and the CSV. Quick note: we’re happy to support pilots, but because this is an additional request so soon after your Q2 pilot credits, I need to run this past our credit-approval and fraud-detection team before any top-ups are issued. Can you confirm whether these teams are linked to different billing domains or if they’re under the same org umbrella? Also: have any of these teams requested separate trial accounts previously?

I’ll loop in our approvals team and get back with next steps by EOD.

—Olga
Account Manager | Redwood Inference
attachments: doc-Verifications.pdf

From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-05T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Requesting promo credits for multiple teams

Forwarding Alex's note. Tagging Marissa and Sean — can we get a quick check for any patterns that would indicate credit-cycling or coordinated reuse across Snowbound? Their request volume looks higher than normal and three different internal teams asking rapid follow-ups is a red flag for potential policy abuse.

Marissa — can you pull the recent account activity (last 90 days)? Specifically: number of distinct signups tied to their domains, overlapping IPs, and any repeated trial-to-paid conversions. If suspicious, we should hold approvals pending verification.

Ben
Senior Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai, olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-05T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Requesting promo credits for multiple teams

Ben / Olga — I pulled the logs and attached a short export. Quick summary:
- There are 7 distinct account records in our system that reference snowbound.ai emails, created over the last 60 days.
- Three of the records share the same device fingerprint/IP ranges over multiple sessions.
- Two accounts have previously received promo/top-up credits in the past 45 days.
- We see overlapping API keys used across two account IDs; one key was created after the first batch of credits was applied.

This looks like coordinated reuse rather than separate autonomous teams. I recommend pausing any new credits until we have confirmation from Snowbound on account ownership and a verification of team membership.

Attaching: promotion-requests.csv (from Alex), account-activity-export.csv, suspicious-keys.txt

-Marissa
Risk & Fraud Analyst | Redwood Inference

From: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@snowbound.ai>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-05T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Requesting promo credits for multiple teams

Alex — thanks for the fast response earlier. We completed an initial review and found some indicators that the requests are originating from a small number of account records with shared keys and overlapping IPs. To proceed we need the following from Snowbound:

1) A short attestation naming the team leads for each requested allocation and confirming they are separate legal teams (PDF acceptable).
2) A list of email addresses and the internal org chart that show these are distinct teams.
3) Confirmation of intended use (datasets, expected token volumes) for each top-up.

Per our promo policy (https://www.redwood.ai/promo-policy), we cannot approve additional credits until ownership and separation are verified. If you can provide the attestation and the org list, we can fast-track a one-time exception review with a senior approvals manager. In the meantime, we are placing a temporary hold on automated top-ups for associated account IDs.

If you disagree with the hold, please indicate that explicitly and provide the verification documents — otherwise we’ll proceed with the pause to protect both parties from accidental chargebacks/abuse.

—Olga Petrov
Account Manager | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0186
Redwood Inference
